gather.answer: Draft answer for 4.1.3, from the evidence found.

requirements.reason: The standard sets how accounts are created, changed and removed; the third-quarter record shows it done.

citations.quote: Accounts and passwords that a manufacturer sets in advance are disabled or given a new password before a system goes live.

requirements.reason: Every user has a personal account, and the settings check found no shared sign-in accounts beyond the listed shop floor displays.

citations.quote: Personal accounts | User account standard | Every sign-in account belongs to one person, apart from the six shop floor display accounts on the list

Accounts shared by several people are allowed only on shop floor terminals that show production data and change nothing, where knowing who did what is not needed; each such account is listed with its purpose.

requirements.reason: Shared accounts only on read-only shop floor terminals, each listed with its purpose.

citations.quote: Accounts shared by several people are allowed only on shop floor terminals that show production data and change nothing, where knowing who did what is not needed; each such account is listed with its purpose.

requirements.reason: Accounts are disabled on the last working day; each leaver in the record was.

citations.quote: IT disables the accounts at the end of the last working day, and deletes them 90 days later.

requirements.reason: A six-monthly review is set, but no record shows one took place.

citations.quote: When someone leaves, all their rights end with their accounts under the user account standard.
Accounts are reviewed with the access rights in the periodic access review set out in the access rights policy.

requirements.reason: First passwords are handed over in person or by text message to the work phone, but no record shows it done.

citations.quote: IT hands the first password to the new user in person, or sends it by text message to the user's work phone.

requirements.reason: The password rules are set out, and the settings check found the length rule enforced and the password manager on every laptop.

citations.quote: Password length and leaked-password check | Authentication standard | 12 characters at least; a known leaked password was refused
Never write a password down or keep it unencrypted; use the company's password manager.

requirements.reason: New accounts start with a basic role for email and the intranet, and the account changes record shows each new account given it.

citations.quote: A new account starts with the basic role every employee has, which gives email, the intranet and nothing more; further rights follow the access rights policy.

requirements.reason: Manufacturer accounts are disabled before go-live, and the settings check found them disabled on the four new systems.

citations.quote: Manufacturer accounts | User account standard | Disabled or given a new password on the four systems that went live this quarter
Accounts and passwords that a manufacturer sets in advance are disabled or given a new password before a system goes live.

requirements.reason: Accounts are created only after HR and the line manager sign off, and the account changes record shows both dates for each new account.

citations.quote: The line manager confirms the request, and IT creates the account only after both have signed off.

requirements.reason: Each new account in the record has HR's request and the manager's confirmation.

citations.quote: Accounts shared by several people are allowed only on shop floor terminals that show production data and change nothing, where knowing who did what is not needed; each such account is listed with its purpose.

requirements.reason: The service provider's account was disabled the day the job ended.

citations.quote: IT-4495 | Service provider, finished job | 2026-08-07 | 2026-08-07 | due 2026-11-05
Accounts of service providers are disabled the day their job is finished, as purchasing tells IT.

requirements.reason: Disable on the last working day and delete 90 days later.

citations.quote: IT disables the accounts at the end of the last working day, and deletes them 90 days later.

requirements.reason: First passwords must be changed, but nothing says the systems enforce it.

citations.quote: The user must change it at the first login.

requirements.reason: Users keep tokens with them and block a lost one themselves, but no record shows tokens handled that way.

citations.quote: Users keep their hardware token with them and never leave it in their laptop.

requirements.reason: A review that includes accounts in customers' systems is set, but none is recorded.

citations.quote: Our staff's accounts in customers' systems are reviewed by the manager responsible for that customer.
Accounts are reviewed with the access rights in the periodic access review set out in the access rights policy.

requirements.reason: Technical accounts cannot sign in interactively, and the settings check found it refused for two of them.

citations.quote: Technical accounts | User account standard | Interactive sign-in denied; tried with two technical accounts and refused
Technical accounts used by services cannot log in interactively.
